headline: Indian rupee hits six-week high against dollar on IPO inflows
summary: The Indian rupee strengthened sharply against the U.S. dollar, supported by foreign currency inflows tied to upcoming initial public offerings and central bank support.
why: Currency exchange rates affect import costs, inflation, and foreign portfolio returns for international investors operating in emerging markets.
